title: Why were Naruto and Safine handed suspended sentences over Jean Pormanove? Here’s what we know
summary_full: Owen Cenazandotti and Safine Hamadi, two French streamers, received suspended sentences for their actions during streamed content. The court has prohibited them from uploading any online material for six months. Their content, aired from 2023 to 2025, showcased disturbing violence against people. Despite calls for stricter consequences, their sentences remain on hold unless they breach conditions set by the court.
